anchor.semantic_hook: Taking a cue from a source is staged as physically lifting a pointed starting baton from that source and carrying it to a new project.
anchor.setting: A quiet creative studio contains a source pedestal, an unfinished-project bench, storage shelves, and a narrow groove linking the two work areas. The sole surreal feature is an enormous needle-shaped brass starting baton that pierces whichever source occupies the pedestal and reaches nearly to the project bench.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous brass starting baton piercing the source object

inserts.action: leans over the source pedestal, pulls the brass baton from the old book, and reaches toward the mixing bowl with eager concentration

variations.scene_adjust: an old clasped recipe book with unmarked pages, a mixing bowl, fresh ingredients, and a flour-dusted rolling pin

inserts.action: kneels between the two work areas, lifts the baton from the natural forms, and aligns its point with the unfinished building model

variations.scene_adjust: branches, shells, stones, and leaves on the source pedestal, with an unfinished building model on the project bench

inserts.action: draws the baton from the open periodical and sets its point beside a blank notebook, holding a pen ready with a thoughtful smile

variations.scene_adjust: an open periodical containing photographs and empty geometric blocks, beside a blank notebook and pen

variations.scene_adjust: two miniature customer-service counters with headsets, bells, chairs, and queue ropes

variations.scene_adjust: a hammock, soft slippers, a tea cup, a folded blanket, and a breathing cushion on the source pedestal

inserts.action: sorts autumn leaves around a blank circular badge and guides the baton from the leaves toward the unfinished badge

variations.scene_adjust: crisp autumn leaves, acorns, a blank circular badge, drawing tools, and an empty display card

anchor.semantic_hook: Being in power is staged literally by standing atop a physical source of electrical power.

anchor.absurd_element: a colossal electrical socket serving as the seat of power

crouches at the foot of the dais, counts the mounting coin tokens, and looks upward with mounting dismay

variations.scene_adjust: a steep stack of coin tokens and several household bills shown only through object icons

variations.scene_adjust: bundles of blank ceremonial cards, some carefully tied and others crumpled behind the dais
